notes.title: 🏋️‍♂️MAJOR UPDATE coming a bit later 🏋️‍♀️
notes.content:
Hey Gym Managers!

We previously announced that a MAJOR UPDATE for Gym Manager would drop on July 17th. However, as we work hard to polish every last detail, we’ve decided to push the release just a little - to July 24th.


We know waiting can be tough, but we truly believe the extra time will help us deliver a much better experience. Thank you so much for your patience and support!


Here’s what you can expect in the upcoming update:

Fixed Level 12 requirements

Fixed rotation of classic metal closet

Fixed issue with removing closet with bench

Improved text placement

Improved ratings performance

Added borderless display mode

Added requirements UI to the Bazaar

Made minor localization improvements

Adjusted task completion logic

Various other minor fixes

Added global illumination

Improved lighting

Added correct local lights

Added local specular reflections

Added particle effects

Improved day/night cycle

Improved materials of environmental objects

Added environmental objects

New translations will include: Bulgarian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Norwegian, Latin American Spanish, Swedish, Thai, Ukrainian, Vietnamese, Hungarian, and Indonesian!


Thanks again for sticking with us - we can’t wait for you to try it out on July 24th! 💪

notes.title: 🏋️‍♂️ MAJOR UPDATE IS COMING 🏋️‍♀️
notes.content:
July 17 - mark your calendars!

A big update is on the way, bringing major improvements to visuals, lighting, performance, and UI. You can also expect a better day/night cycle, more environment details, and a bunch of bug fixes 🛠️



✨ Plus, we're expanding language support!
New translations will include: Bulgarian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Norwegian, Latin American Spanish, Swedish, Thai, Ukrainian, Vietnamese, Hungarian, and Indonesian!



Stay tuned - it’s going to be the biggest update yet! 💪



See you soon,
Gym Manager Team

notes.title: Hotfix #5
notes.content:
- Throwing boxes will no longer bug the game
- There was a slim to none chance that you would be able to get bugged item from lockpicking, that is fixed
- Bet prize and bet amount balanced
- Bet bugs fixed
- Member forgotten item dialogue stuck bug fixed
- Stuck customers bug fixed
- Level won't drop if you remove the old equipment but I suggest you don't remove them, because variety effects the membership fee
- Italian localization bugs fixed
- Sauna state resetting bug on save/load fixed
- Not removable decorations/equipment etc. fixed
- Equipment stealing quest will take into account older stolen equipment
- Guard shouldn't be stuck hitting the same customer
- Members will need more resting benches and won't sit at the same bench
- Supplements are more profitable

notes.title: Hotfix #4
notes.content:
- Stuck quest bug
- Game not autosaving bug
- Italian localization bug

notes.title: Hotfix #3
notes.content:
Fixed/Changed:
-	Money will no longer be stuck under the ground
-	Money Stacks will always glow when not paying members are knocked down
-	French localization fixes
-	Illegal supplement Money is earned immediately when the item is sold
-	Guard will put stolen supplements to Player inventory if it has enough space
-	Fixed a bug with missing supplements
-	Slot machine takes less time to spin
-	Quests should no longer be stuck(Report if bug happens again)
-	Trash will no longer be stuck underground
-	Forgotten items will not be requested repeatedly by members
-	Supplements are less profitable

Working on:

-	Not saved bets with “Daddy”
-	“Daddy” bets balance
